notes: 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE Maya) — Silverpine is rebuilding their real-time bidding inference stack to move model execution off internal infra. Interested in dedicated GPU pools to guarantee throughput for peak auctions.

POC config notes: reserved pool proposal = 8x H100-equivalent GPUs; baseline runs on H100/80GB profiles. Autoscaling burst to shared pool optional.
Model-specific tuning discussed:

- Context length: most production traffic uses 256-512 tokens; occasional long-context requests up to 2048 for debugging. Plan: optimize kernels for 512 and enable 2-tier fallback for >1024 to a quantized variant.
- Quantization: initial plan q4_0 for 70B model (balance perf/accuracy) for dedicated nodes; evaluate int8 and q8 on lower-latency critical path. Need success criteria: <3% drop in rerank NDCG.
- Batching strategy: continuous batching with max batch size 48 for chat; concurrency cap at 64 for short requests. P95 latency target assumes batching window <= 12ms.
- KV cache settings: aggressive prefix caching for repeated session tokens; measure hit-rate expected >60% for chat sessions. Propose sticky routing to maintain KV locality in reserved pool.
Perf results (2026-02-20 benchmark run):
- 70B q4_0 on 8x H100-equivalent: avg 1.8ms/token for generation, p95 latency 95ms for 256-token seq under targeted concurrency (simulated 400 rps).
- Reranker (pairwise scoring) optimized w/ batching: throughput 1100 pair-evals/sec, p95 42ms.
- KV cache hit-rate measured ~68% during chat simulation; estimated token-cost reduction ~28%.
Business/SLA items:
- Silverpine requests hard SLO: p95 <120ms for standard payloads (<=512 tokens), 99.9% uptime for dedicated pool during business hours, credits for misses. Legal wants explicit remediation language.
